description: TennisExplorer ATP/WTA match results for one day from the public results page: tournament, start time, both players with seed, sets won, set scores and pre-match home/away odds as the site lists them. Only matches listed for that day. Related tools on this server, for a different need: dev_flashscore when you need Flashscore match list for one sport and day: every match; dev_bundlephobia when you need npm package bundle size from Bundlephobia's public size. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

tour.description: atp-single (default), atp-double, wta-single, wta-double or all
